deployment.configuration: Public /client-config.json: schemaVersion=1, optional homeCoreUrl/homeMatrixUrl/authUrl. Default Core and auth are the actual client origin. No query parameter or discovered URL changes these targets.
deployment.origins: New split-origin deployments require HTTPS or loopback HTTP. Existing trusted HTTP same-origin deployments, including private IP origins and their home-discovered private Matrix URL, remain compatible. Matrix is informational/binding metadata: the browser sends ordinary tokens only to home Core/auth API endpoints.
deployment.legacy: Unbound ds-group.session migrates only when home Core and auth both equal the browser origin. v2 session keys pin these services; rooms/drafts/retries additionally bind full user ID, central subject/authority, space and room. Authenticated /me upgrades legacy subjects without losing pending transactions.
deployment.build: npm run build creates dist/web; client-config.json is validated and copied into the PWA shell. No package/lock change. Vite adds /.well-known/dscord development proxy. Runtime root hosting only; no URL subdirectory support.
deployment.cors: Exact client origin, Authorization/Content-Type/X-Upload-Id, business methods and preflight. Every credential-bearing fetch uses credentials:omit, redirect:error, cache:no-store. Upload uses fetch with cancellation and stable X-Upload-Id; progress is indeterminate until a real receipt.

identity.matched: central-identity contract 1.0.0, backend commit 425fb34e89e361479bb02ce9a9728df6ff32b808 in real central verification
identity.emptyHome: /api/bootstrap roomId:null is supported; registration and first group creation work with zero initial joined rooms.

collaboration.semantics: All requests use the home Core. Connected is labeled Accessible, not remote online. Joined/restricted/invited/approval_required come from backend facts; local failed join attempts show server rejection or unknown result without creating a phantom space. Matrix opaque v12 room IDs and legacy room IDs are both accepted.
collaboration.legacy: 404 for spaces/directory falls back to verified /api/rooms membership, never public bootstrap room claims.
collaboration.future: /api/servers and persistent application/request workflow remain future backend routes. No fake requested/approved memberships are persisted by the client.

rooms.scope: Full room/member/event IDs preserve home identity across spaces. Late polls, sends, metadata and direct-room navigation are checked against their originating session and view. Drafts and uploads retain producing space; switching during a send is supported.
rooms.permissions: Server invitation action is shown only with room.permissions.inviteMembers === true. Home-room creation is an ordinary authenticated home action; remote server operations are absent. Role editing is separate collaboration UI and requires the backend canManage result.
rooms.attachmentProof: Attachment reads include the originating full roomId query. Real home upload/download verified. Foreign media proof/resolution requires the governance/media backend slice; synthetic cross-space byte routing is not counted as real federation.

push.clientBehavior: Subscription owner is scoped to home authority and full user ID. SW persists recipient binding only, not token/message data. A foreign or stale bound recipient is ignored; an unbound legacy notification is generic and opens home without deep-linking. Open-room messages also recheck actual home room membership.
push.backendGap: Current push.mjs payload lacks userId/homeCoreUrl/authorityId. Main/backend integration should add them per recipient before claiming full identity-bound mobile push delivery.

clientSettings.bots: Separate My Bots dialog only exposes accounts actually returned in ownedBots with the current full owner ID. A foreign directory ownerId does not grant management.
clientSettings.administration: No deployment/node/budget/storage/admin configuration menu in personal settings.

productionBrowserFixture.origins: actual separate loopback origins plus route-backed ordinary HTTP private-origin compatibility

integratedBackend.finding: After creating a room via normal UI, the selected space contained no selectable channel. Retained as a separate integration failure; no client membership bypass.
integratedBackend.diagnostics: GET /api/rooms returned the created joined room (200); direct Matrix state returned its local creator; Matrix /sync rooms.join was empty and /api/spaces home.rooms remained empty (200). Client did not infer an admitted space from this conflict.
